jobs.occupation: Senior System Engineer  Pro Robotics  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Our dynamic Pro Robotics R&D team, consisting of around 100 people, is expanding, and we are investing further in Pro Robotics solutions. We are seeking a Senior System Engineer to join our System & Test group. Our group currently includes 10 people, containing both Technical Project Managers, System Engineers, and System Testers.

We believe in optimizing customer value by taking a solutions perspective. Our responsibility includes professional robotic products and related digital solutions. This offers the opportunity to work in a focused and agile team with cutting-edge technology across various engineering fields. We solve complex problems together with highly skilled colleagues from other disciplines, contributing to a more sustainable world.

Role Description
As a Senior System Engineer, you will be responsible for the overall requirements and design of the Pro robotic lawnmower products and solutions. You will tackle complex questions to find the best solutions by integrating electronics, software, and mechanics. In this central role, you will often lead cross-disciplinary technical teams and ensure comprehensive system documentation, both internally and externally.

Your profile
You are a goal-oriented, analytical, and communicative professional who takes responsibility for your work. You are open-minded, curious, and eager to learn and develop new technologies alongside your colleagues.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
Extensive experience in product development and/or systems engineering, with expertise in at least two of the following areas: embedded software, electronics, mechanics, or mechatronics.
Practical experience in requirements management.
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus

Additional experience in the following areas is a plus
Leading technical teams or projects
Working with autonomous systems or robotics
Certification or Functional Safety

Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your Application
Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we apply ongoing selection. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.
For more information about the position please contact Hiring Manager Elias Josefsson at elias.josefsson @husqvarnagroup.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact, Talent Acquisition Partner Gorjana Dubovina at gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 

Learn more about our culture here.

The opportunity
We are a team of 15+ professionals located across multiple sites, delivering Automation & Communication solutions for HVDC projects worldwide. Our scope includes Auxiliary Automation Systems, SCADA, RTU, Communication Systems, and Cybersecurity, supporting projects throughout their lifecycle.
Our team brings diverse technical and project backgrounds, enabling us to adapt to the dynamic project environment while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and customer expectations. We are responsible for defining work breakdown structures, planning deliverables, and driving successful project execution.
We are looking for a motivated engineer who is eager to develop within Auxiliary Automation and contribute to innovative HVDC projects. In this role, you will work closely with experienced colleagues and gain hands-on experience with control and monitoring solutions for critical infrastructure. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys technology, problem-solving, and collaboration in an international environment.
How you'll make an impact
Be proactive and solution oriented.
Support the design, implementation, and testing of Auxiliary Automation solutions for HVDC projects.
Work with control and monitoring systems for auxiliary equipment and plant services.
Assist in the integration of automation systems with communication networks and other project disciplines.
Collaborate with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders throughout project execution.
Contribute to technical documentation, system testing, and project deliverables.
Learn and develop within a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

Your background
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
Interest in industrial automation, control systems, or auxiliary plant systems.
Basic understanding of PLCs, HMI systems, industrial communication, or automation technologies is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of communication protocols and networking concepts is beneficial.
Experience through internships, coursework, thesis projects, or early-career engineering roles is valuable.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a global environment.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:Are you passionate about logistics, customer service, and international trade? We are looking for an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator to join our team in Örebro. This is position within Epiroc's Global/Regional Distribution Center, where you will play an important role in ensuring reliable and efficient deliveries to customers around the world.
 You will be part of an international team and collaborate with colleagues, customers, freight forwarders, and customs partners across multiple regions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a supportive and fast-evolving environment where digital tools, systems, and business processes are continuously being developed and improved.
 Your Mission
 As an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the flow of customer orders from receipt to delivery, helping to ensure a seamless customer experience.
 In this role, you will coordinate customer orders and provide support to Customer Centers and Distribution Centers.
 You will handle export administration and trade documentation, oversee invoicing and shipping activities, and monitor deliveries to ensure they arrive on time.
 You will work closely with freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse teams, and internal stakeholders to maintain efficient operations and ensure compliance with export control, customs, and trade regulations.
 Each team member supports a designated portfolio of Customer Centers and Distribution Centers worldwide and serves as their main point of contact, building strong relationships and contributing to excellent service.
Profile description:Your Profile
 We believe you bring a combination of expertise, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to your work.
 You likely have a university degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, economics, or a related field. Or have developed equivalent knowledge and skills through extensive relevant work experience.
 Experience within international logistics, export operations, customer order management or supply chain activities will help you succeed in this position.
 Knowledge of trade compliance, customs procedures, and Letters of Credit is valuable, as is experience working with M3 and Oracle Transportation Management (OTM).
 You are comfortable working with different IT systems and enjoy learning new tools and processes.
 You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing. You have a structured and detail-oriented way of working, while maintaining a strong customer focus.
 You enjoy solving problems, identifying improvements, and collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
 You are comfortable managing several priorities at the same time and adapt well to change in a dynamic environment.
 Most importantly, you are a team player who values cooperation, builds positive relationships, and contributes to a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
 Application and Contacts
 The position is based in Örebro, Sweden.
 Application and contactsPlease send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 25th of November.
  Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

jobs.occupation: MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity 
Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
  
 Your journey in the Innovate program will start as an MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver, supporting Mission Critical Networks (MCN) and Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) in safety-critical contexts. You will help teams deliver dependable support for customers such as defence organizations and government agencies. 
 What you will do  
You will help ensure that mission-critical network projects are supported from early planning through deployment and live operation. This includes integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)—technology that allows a wireless network to provide connectivity and also detect or monitor objects and activity in its environment. In safety-critical settings, dependable service and clear support arrangements are essential. 
  
  Connect pre-sales and deployment teams with RAN software and hardware support teams, using your view of the radio portfolio to help set clear expectations and move from product-by-product support to coordinated, end-to-end support.
 Define practical support processes, case triage, escalation routes and clear responsibilities across radio, transport, core network, applications, customer operations, system integrators and third-party partners, bringing structure and operational leadership to cross-functional ways of working.
 Coordinate proactively with design, solution, customer, project and operations teams so support needs and responsibilities are clear and considered early in project planning.
 Join early studies, proofs of concept and pilot projects. Use lab environments to validate support approaches, reproduce faults and test complete solutions.
 Identify gaps in skills, tools, infrastructure and security practices; develop training and practical troubleshooting guides; and share lessons from customer cases to improve future solutions.
 Participate in live support cases, identify recurring issues, track readiness and performance, and recommend improvements. 
  You will bring  
We provide a platform for you to contribute to technology and services that matter in safety-critical situations. 
 Bring initiative: ask questions, take responsibility for your work, and collaborate across teams to turn support needs into clear actions. 
     In addition you have    MSc or BSc in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent, with 3–5 years of relevant experience.
 Ability to structure complex problems, take initiative, define ways of working and prioritize actions; project-planning experience is helpful but can be developed on the job.
 Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to work across organizational, technical and cultural boundaries and drive change.
 Curiosity to explore emerging MCN/ISAC use cases, learn quickly and adapt in a changing environment, with a proactive, action-oriented mindset.
 Working knowledge of RAN software and hardware, the radio portfolio, wireless communication and network architecture; familiarity with mission-critical communications is an advantage.
 Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or deployment of complex network solutions; experience with labs, PoCs or security considerations is an advantage.
 Strong stakeholder coordination, communication and analytical skills, with proficiency in English and an ability to lead operational work across teams. 
  
Pre-offer checks including references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

jobs.occupation: Accounts Payable Specialist wanted in Boden
jobs.description:
Are you a structured and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist with a passion for order, structure, and efficiency? Do you have experience in accounts payable within production, warehouse, or logistics and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Then this might be the right challenge for you!
About the position 
Perido is looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist on behalf of our client, an industrial enterprise driving large-scale initiatives within green energy and manufacturing. The position is located in Boden, with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.
Your daily tasks
In the role of AP Specialist, you will work in a fast-paced environment where you will be responsible for all parts of the accounts payable process with high accuracy and compliance.
These are the main focus tasks:
Manage and drive the accounts payable (AP) process with a focus on accuracy and adherence to internal controls
Work proactively to efficiently and accurately handle and correct historical transactions
Maintain order and structure in AP processes and ensure clear documentation
Adapt to a changing business environment and contribute with problem-solving skills and flexibility
Create stability, focus, and a calm, structured work atmosphere even under high pressure

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is highly structured, detail-oriented, and passionate about order and efficiency. You are a flexible thinker who understands the importance of correcting historical transactions and easily adapts to changing business needs. You thrive in a high-tempo, energetic environment where you maintain your focus and contribute calm and stability even in high-pressure situations.
Is this a challenge you would like to take on? We look forward to reading your application, welcome with your application today!
Qualifications:
Experience working with accounts payable within production, warehouse, or logistics
Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Meritorious:
Experience in SAP or Medius is highly advantageous

Contract type and hours
Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-11-02. Start asap.
Application
Please apply through our website at perido.se/lediga-jobb/. Simply click the "Apply" button in the job advertisement, fill in your details, and upload your CV. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible, as the selection process is ongoing. Please note that some details about the assignment and/or client company may have been deliberately disclosed in the advertisement. If your profile matches what the client is looking for and you are contacted by a recruiter, you will receive all the information you need.
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still haven't found the answer you are looking for, you are most welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se and one of our Recruitment Communicators will answer you. Always enter the reference number 36077 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status.
About Perido
Why is our company named Perido? The name comes from the Latin word Peridoneus, which means 'well-matched'. Perido is a consulting and recruitment company specializing in the white-collar sector, dedicated to helping you take the next step in your career. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.
Denna position rapporterar till:
Global Head of Sales & Marketing
__
Help customers make steel and aluminum production more efficient. At ABB, you will work with technologies that support more productive and sustainable industry. In this international sales role, you will grow ABB Metallurgy Products in selected export markets and build lasting partnerships with customers around the world.
Your role and responsibilities
ABB Metallurgy is a global supplier of electromagnetic stirring and braking systems for the steel and aluminum industries. As Area Sales Manager, you will manage sales in your assigned markets, develop new opportunities and work with colleagues across ABB to shape strong customer solutions - from the first discussion through offer and delivery.
The position is based in Västerås, Sweden. You will report to the Global Sales and Marketing Manager, Metallurgy Products, and travel regularly to your markets, up to approximately 50%.
Develop market plans for your assigned territories and deliver against sales volume and margin targets; review performance and agree recovery actions where needed.
Lead sales activities and build trusted, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their priorities and providing a responsive experience.
Identify, qualify and pursue new business opportunities in existing and emerging markets.
Work with global colleagues to communicate ABB’s value proposition and support effective marketing activities.
Coordinate customer offers with the Global Sales Manager, ensuring proposals are technically sound and commercially accurate.
Manage sales administration and support project activities when required.
Track market developments and competitor activity, sharing insights that inform sales plans and help address risks.

Your background
A relevant degree in engineering, business or a related field.
B2B sales experience is valued, and candidates with a strong technical background are encouraged to apply, even if they have only a few years of sales experience.
Experience in the steel and/or aluminum industry is an advantage.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a customer-focused and professional approach.
Fluent English, spoken and written.
A proactive, adaptable working style and willingness to travel internationally, up to approximately 50%.

More about us
We develop and deliver electromagnetic stirrers and braking systems to steel and aluminum producers worldwide. Our solutions support important production processes such as melting and casting, helping customers improve process performance and use resources more efficiently. Our R&D and Simulations teams use advanced calculation tools and multiphysics models to assess and optimize electromagnetic actuation, including in customer projects.
For questions about the position, contact Recruiting Manager Marcus Ekman at +46 70 291 29 08. Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer – Mikael Blomqvist, +46 768 06 00 11; Ledarna – Leif Öhrberg, +46 724 64 40 16; Unionen – Krista Andersson, +46 706 44 02 85.
For other questions, contact Talent Partner Irma Leijon at +46 72 461 23 14. We kindly ask staffing and recruitment agencies and sellers of additional job advertisements not to contact us directly.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply through ABB’s careers site. We look forward to hearing from you.

Your New Role 
We are looking for a HR Business Partner to our well-known client in Södertälje. You’ll join a pilot that brings rehabilitation, disciplinary matters and workplace investigations into one central HR function, primarily supporting production units.
You’ll take ownership of cases from initial assessment through follow-up. Working in a central team of three to five HR Business Partners, you’ll collaborate closely with managers, local HR teams, employees and trade union representatives. You’ll apply the client’s established methods while helping the team build a consistent approach across business units.
What you’ll do

Lead employee relations investigations and manage sensitive cases independently.

Coordinate workplace rehabilitation cases and guide managers through the process.

Handle misconduct and disciplinary matters and investigate reports of bullying, victimisation or harassment.

Lead difficult conversations with employees, managers and other stakeholders, and communicate your assessments clearly.

Advise local HR and managers in production and other business areas on how to move complex cases forward.

Company Presentation
Our client is a global leader in the automotive industry, with operations in 100 countries. At their headquarters near Stockholm, they work on developing sustainable transport systems – mobility solutions that benefit businesses, society, and the environment. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your innovation and technical expertise to projects shaping the future of transportation, in an organization where collaboration, growth, and sustainability are key.
Good to Know
Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Working model: Primarily on-site, with some flexibility to work remotely depending on case needs. Start date: As soon as possible End date: 2027-12-31, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.
To succeed in this role, you will need: 
An academic degree in HR, behavioral science, law or a related field.

5–10 years of relevant HR case management experience, including rehabilitation, misconduct or disciplinary matters, employee relations investigations and difficult employee conversations.

Experience independently handling sensitive and complex employee matters in a large organization.

The ability to quickly learn and apply internal procedures and work effectively across business units.

Strong communication skills and confidence leading sensitive meetings and discussions.

Fluency in English.

Meritorious: Experience in a large industrial or production organization.

Meritorious: Knowledge of work environment and occupational health matters, employment law, or internal frameworks for rehabilitation and workplace investigations is also valued.

What we Offer
Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

Additional compensation during parental leave

Occupational health services

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application 
We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

Vi är stolta över Trollhättans stads över 5 000 medarbetare, som varje dag gör en positiv skillnad i våra invånares liv och är med och utvecklar stadens hållbarhet och livskraft. Vi drivs och motiveras av ledorden Mod, Delaktighet, Nytänkande och Handlingskraft. Här finns en spännande utveckling där du kan vara med och göra vår stad ännu bättre.
Är du en engagerad och kreativ musiklärare som vill arbeta i en skola där trygghet, utveckling och lärande står i fokus? Då är Paradisskolan rätt plats för dig!
Vi söker en legitimerad musiklärare som vill undervisa våra elever i årskurs 4–9. Undervisningen sker både i helklass och halvklass, främst i årskurs 6 och 9. I tjänsten ingår även mentorskap för en klass tillsammans med en kollega.
Hos oss möter du cirka 400 elever med olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder – en mångfald som vi ser som en stor styrka. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna sig sedd, lyssnad på och motiverad att utvecklas.
Om Paradisskolan
Paradisskolan ligger centralt i Källstorp i västra Trollhättan. Här finns även English Speaking Class (ESC) där undervisningen i SO och NO sker på engelska. Vi tar emot elever från hela Trollhättan och stora delar av världen, vilket skapar en levande och internationell skolmiljö.
Vårt utvecklingsarbete fokuserar på hög kvalitet i undervisningen och en god miljö för lärande. Vi arbetar utifrån vår vision:
”Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden genom form, förutsättningar och förväntan.”
Vi tror på att:
* Alla vill lyckas.
* Framgång skapas gemensamt.
* Vi möter varandra med nyfikenhet och respekt.
* Vi prövar olika arbetssätt så att alla kan nå sin fulla potential.
Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad musiklärare med en bred ämneskunskap inom musik. Du kan inspirera eleverna genom varierad och kreativ undervisning där lusten att skapa, uttrycka sig och utforska musiken står i centrum.
Du har ett relationellt ledarskap där du bygger trygga, respektfulla och professionella relationer med eleverna. Du leder undervisningen med tydlighet, värme och struktur och du möter elevernas olika behov och erfarenheter med flexibilitet och engagemang.
Vi vill att du:
* är trygg i din roll och fungerar som en positiv förebild för eleverna
* arbetar med strategier som skapar studiero, motivation och arbetsglädje
* använder dialog, nyfikenhet och respekt för att skapa goda relationer
* har god kännedom om skolans styrdokument och kan omsätta dem i praktiken
* har goda IKT-kunskaper och använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av undervisningen
* vill bidra till skolans utveckling och delta i kollegialt lärande tillsammans med övriga lärare
* har en vilja att hitta lösningar och anpassningar så att varje elev kan nå sitt bästa jag
Vi ser att du brinner för undervisning, relationsskapande och för att göra skillnad – varje dag.
Anställningsinformation
Utdrag ur Belastningsregistret är obligatoriskt vid arbete med barn.
Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.
Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons!
Trollhättan är en stark och attraktiv kommun som ska bli större. I dag är vi ca 59 000 invånare och vi har siktet inställt på att växa till 70 000 trollhättebor. Inom Trollhättans stad arbetar vi med att skapa förutsättningar för detta. Vi är över 5 000 medarbetare och våra 350 olika yrken bidrar på olika sätt med att ge service och underlätta en bra vardag för våra invånare - nu och i framtiden. Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund.
Trollhättans stad tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

Are you an analytical and business-oriented Financial Controller who enjoys working with financial reporting, analysis and budgeting? In this role, you will take responsibility for assigned departments, combining financial controlling with business partnering and supporting the business through accurate reporting and forecasting.
About the position
Perido are looking for a Financial Controller for our client, an exciting and forward-thinking company in the automotive industry. The position is based in Gothenburg.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will be responsible for financial controlling and business partnering for assigned departments, including monthly financial reporting, analysis, budgeting and forecasting. You will also be responsible for accruals, capitalization and providing financial documentation for audits.
Key responsibilities: 
Act as the responsible controller and business partner for assigned departments
Be responsible for monthly financial reporting and analysis to group functions, including FP&A and Accounting, as well as to the business team
Manage the accrual and capitalization process, including hourly rate calculations, and ensure timely delivery of input to Group Accounting during month-end closing
Support the business in the budget and forecast process
Provide supporting documentation for internal and external audits related to assigned control functions
Perform ad hoc reporting and analysis
Act as the finance approver for assigned departments

Your characteristics
To succeed in this role, you are analytical and business-oriented, with a strong ability to understand and interpret financial information. You communicate clearly and effectively, adapting your communication to both finance professionals and other stakeholders. You are also structured and independent, with the ability to plan, coordinate and prioritize your work while remaining flexible and handling ad hoc requests. Furthermore, you enjoy collaborating with others and feel comfortable working both independently and as part of diverse teams.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
5+ years’ experience in financial controlling
Strong business acumen and strong analytical skills
Good at interpret and communicate financial information in a clear and concise way
Good in excel and relevant ERP and business analytics tools
Being able to plan and coordinate work independently as well as jointly in diversified teams
Good at prioritize and be able to handle ad hoc requests
Good at communicate financial information to both finance and non-finance

Contract type and hours
Full-time consulting assignment for 6 months. Start immediately.

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. Product Development Engineer
Turn Innovation into Life-Changing Medical Technology
About the Role
Smartwise Sweden AB is looking for an experienced Product Development Engineer to develop minimally invasive medical devices, with a focus on catheter-based endovascular technologies.
You will work across the product lifecycle—from new development and product improvements to new configurations—partnering with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, suppliers and manufacturers to deliver safe, robust and manufacturable solutions.
This is a hands-on role with ownership, complex problem-solving and a clear impact on next-generation medical technology.

jobs.description:
We need more people - join our team!

Say hello to Scandic Go, a fresh, urban hotel concept, offering the essentials with a “get what you need, pay for what you want” mindset. We’re making it possible for more guests to explore the city in their own way. Always smart, always sustainable, and always with smooth self-service. We welcome all tomorrow’s adventurers to Scandic Go.

What's it like being a Host at Scandic Go?As a Host at Scandic Go, you're all about the guest. You greet them warmly when they arrive and help them with online check in or at our self-service kiosks in the lounge. You also answer any questions they might have.

Check in-out, F&B sales and answering phone- it is a stimulating position and you will be on your feet all day!

You prepare food and drinks. You keep the lounge area neat and cozy so our guests can relax and enjoy themselves. You're always ready to chat with them and share some local tips.

At check-out, you make sure they had a great stay and assist them if needed.

Who are you?We're looking for someone who can juggle multiple things at once and make our guests feel welcome. You should be good at talking to people and fluent in Swedish and English. Other languages are a plus.

But what really matters is who you are and how you act. You should be a responsive and prestige-free team player who are reliable and care about the quality of your work.

About the positionWe're looking for someone to join our team as a host. You'll work on different shifts, including days, evenings and weekends. Your boss will be the Hospitality Manager.

Please apply through our website only. We'll review the applications as they come and we might hire someone before the deadline, so don't wait too long. We'll also give you a short service test during the selection process.

The position includes:

Part time employee
Probationary period

Can't wait to see you!

We are looking for You- your personality and energy is the most important factors.

If you have earlier experiences from Reception, F&B or customer service this will be a plus but not a must.

Intro starting 1st of January 2026

Allt börjar med dig. Att arbeta på ett av våra hotell innebär att vara en del av ett team där omtanke, samarbete och små vardagsögonblick gör skillnad. Du hjälper till att skapa den varma, hemlika känslan som kännetecknar Scandic – genom att vara närvarande, här och nu, och låta detaljerna räknas.

Vissa dagar går snabbt, andra är mer förutsägbara – ingen dag är den andra lik. Men det som alltid består är lagandan. Ni ställer upp för varandra, löser saker när de händer och är stolta över att leverera kvalitet – även när tempot är högt. Och när ni gör det vill gästerna inte bara njuta av sin vistelse – de vill komma tillbaka.

Så arbetar vi på Scandic

Vi är som bäst när vi arbetar tillsammans – över roller, hotell och team – och fokuserar på det som gör verklig skillnad i vardagen. Våra värderingar vägleder hur vi agerar och levererar: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring och Be You.

Om du tror att fantastisk gästfrihet skapas genom samarbete, konsekvent kvalitet och små välgjorda ögonblick, kommer du att känna dig som hemma hos oss.

På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Secure supplier Material compliance with regulatory and sustainability programs, including reporting of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions (EcoVadis), Substances of Concern In Products (SCIP), and Conflict Minerals declaration (CMRT/3TG).
Partner with engineering and supply chain teams on supplier qualifications, quality monitoring, and contract parameter maintenance.
Support operational purchasing in resolving critical supply issues, including quality defects, delivery delays, and service deviations.
Coach and guide internal stakeholders on supplier quality processes, tools, and governance standards.

Qualifications for the role
Relevant educational background in engineering, supply chain management, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in supplier quality, procurement, or quality assurance within an industrial or project-driven environment.
Hands-on proficiency with SAP, SAP Ariba, and Master Data Governance (MDG) and Office365.
Resilient, decisive, and communicative mindset, with the confidence to uphold standards and work through complex challenges with patience and integrity.
Self-driven approach with strong organizational skills and the ability to guide and collaborate across global functions.
Prior knowledge of ABB procurement processes and sustainability frameworks is an advantage.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

ABB Marine & Ports is pioneering sustainable solutions for marine vessels and port operations. Minimum 5-7 years of experience in protection engineering, preferably within HVDC, FACTS, or power transmission systems.
Strong knowledge of HVDC and high voltage substation protection and control systems, including design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection schemes for transmission and distribution networks.
Experience with Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) settings, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or DIgSILENT PowerFactory.
Knowledge of international standards and communication protocols.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in global, multidisciplinary teams.

At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers. We are looking for Technical Lead Exterior Lighting/ Exterior Functions.
Role Summary 
We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Lead / SPOC to lead test automation activities for advanced automotive Exterior Lighting and Exterior Function systems. The role combines technical leadership, test automation strategy, stakeholder management, and onsite-offshore coordination to ensure delivery of high-quality automated verification solutions integrated into Continuous Integration (CI) environments. 
The candidate will act as the primary technical focal point for automation development, validation activities, and cross-functional collaboration across multiple testing levels including vehicle, system, integration, and component verification. 
Key Responsibilities 
Technical Leadership 
Lead and coordinate onsite and offshore test automation teams. 
Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to automation engineers. 
Act as the primary technical interface between development, integration, verification, and CI teams. 
Establish and enforce automation best practices, coding standards, and framework governance. 

Test Automation Strategy 
Define and drive the overall test automation strategy aligned with project goals and quality objectives. 
Develop scalable automation architectures and CI/CD integration approaches. 
Evaluate and adopt innovative techniques, including AI-assisted test generation, where beneficial. 

Test Analysis & Planning 
Analyze requirements, features, and verification needs to identify automation opportunities. 
Develop automation test plans, effort estimates, schedules, and resource strategies. 
Ensure alignment between automation activities, delivery milestones, and program objectives. 

Test Execution & Delivery 
Oversee development, maintenance, and execution of automated test cases. 
Ensure test coverage across:  
Software-in-the-Loop (SIL)
Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) 
Vehicle/System Integration Testing
Component-Level Verification 
Regression and Confirmation Testing
Drive successful deployment of automated tests into CI environments. 

Quality Assurance & Reporting 
Monitor automation progress, quality metrics, risks, and defect trends. 
Lead regular technical reviews and status reporting activities. 
Ensure test automation deliverables meet quality, maintainability, and performance expectations. 
Communicate delivery status and recommendations to stakeholders. 

Domain Support & Collaboration 
Provide technical expertise within: 
Exterior Lighting 
Visibility Systems 
Vehicle Locking Functions 
Alarm Systems
Door and Closure Systems 
Support onsite investigations, manual verification activities, and requirement clarifications. 
Work closely with software development, system integration, CI, and validation teams. 

Required Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or equivalent. 
Proven experience in quality assurance and verification of complex embedded systems.
Experience leading automotive test automation activities and distributed engineering teams.
Strong stakeholder and delivery management capabilities. 
Fluent in written and spoken English. 

Required Technical Skills 
Automotive Test Automation 
Test Automation Framework Design and Architecture 
Automated Test Case Development and Management 
Continuous Integration / Continuous Testing 
Python and/or CAPL scripting
CANoe 
Jenkins or similar CI tools 
Linux 
Requirement and Test Management Tools
Embedded Systems Verification & Validation 
HIL, SIL and Integration Testing 

Preferred Skills 
Experience in Exterior Lighting and Exterior Functions. 
AI-assisted test generation and automation techniques. 
Software development background. 
Model-Based Development and Testing experience. 

Why Join Tata Technologies?
If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on and want to help shape the future of automotive electronic systems, we would love to hear from you.
Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world.

Our work supports HVDC projects across the globe in both real-time and virtual environments.

Participate in all project phases, including software design, development, integration, testing, verification, deployment, and maintenance.

All about the role:
As a Platform Data Engineer, you are an architect and builder of the foundations. You do not just move data; you build the resilient infrastructure, automated tooling, and scalable systems that allow the entire analytics ecosystem to function. 
Your mission is to eliminate human bottlenecks by stitching together complex components into a high-performance, controlled, and reliable data engine. You will match the capabilities and scale of the platform to our unique business requirements, ensuring that every byte of data is stored, orchestrated, and accessed with maximum efficiency and minimum manual intervention.
 
 
What you'll do:
 
●     Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design, build, and maintain the physical and logical architecture of our data platform. You ensure the platform evolves with our needs, moving beyond a "set it and forget it" mentality to a dynamic, scalable system.
●     Ingestion & Integration: Build the ingestion layer to take raw data from various internal and external sources and integrate it seamlessly into the analytical platform for processing.
●     Automation & Developer Experience: Champion the "machine-first" approach by automating repetitive tasks and building software to handle data efficiently. You ensure that data foundations are built on code, not manual inputs or human-heavy workflows.
●     Orchestration & Workflow Management: Turn computational chaos into a controlled ecosystem by designing complex orchestration chains that distribute, monitor, and recover processes automatically.
●     System Reliability & Performance: Optimize SQL queries, schema designs, and distributed processing tasks to ensure the platform remains performant as scale increases.
●     Security & Cost Control: Implement tightly designed access controls and resource management strategies to ensure compliance and prevent cloud bills from skyrocketing.
 
Qualifications:
●     Technical Background: Proven track record as a builder in cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure) with a focus on System Design and Architecture.
●     Software Engineering Mindset: Strong foundation in Python development and experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark).
●     Expertise in Data Structures: Deep knowledge of Data Warehouses, Lakes, and Lakehouses, including query optimization and schema design.
●     Automation: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing to ensure platform resilience and maintainability.
●     Problem Solving: The ability to take a complex chain of computations and turn it into a controlled, reliable ecosystem that recovers easily from failure.
 
Valuable extras:
●     Experience in MLOps Engineering to support model development and deployment.
●     Knowledge of Security & Governance frameworks (encryption, access control, and compliance).
●     Familiarity with Observability & Monitoring tools (logging, metrics, and audit trails) to ensure platform health.
